_README: This file lets you update the live app WITHOUT redeploying.
Edit this file on GitHub, hit 'Commit changes', and every visitor
- 'matches' is keyed by the match's index (0-103), shown as 'i' in the app data.
- For KNOCKOUT matches (indices 76-103): once the teams are known,
add h (home team) and a (away team) — the placeholder names
('Winner A', 'Runner-up B', etc.) get replaced everywhere.
- For ANY match: add score (e.g. '2-1') and/or status (e.g. 'FT', 'LIVE', 'HT')
to show a small badge next to the team names.
- Always update the 'updated' timestamp at the top (any ISO date string) —
this is what powers the 'Live results synced' note.
- Delete this _README key if you want (the app ignores unknown keys),
or just leave it — it's harmless.
